name: Cupertino Recreation Event Volunteers (REV)
org: City of Cupertino, Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Volunteer at Cupertino city events like Monster Mash, the Big Bunny 5K, and the Independence Day Celebration. You build leadership skills and earn volunteer hours.
who_can_apply: Students in 9th to 12th grade for that school year who are at least 14. No residency rule is stated.
duration: School year. Members help at 2 or more major events and 2 or more minor events, and go to monthly meetings.
deadline_text: Recruitment is open now. Applications are reviewed four times a year, around September, December, March, and May.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application, including two short questions (300 words max each). You hear back after the next review period.
notes: Some events fall on holidays, weekends, and evenings. Members who do more events are recognized at Bronze, Silver, and Gold levels.
